code:
# Runs the desktop app's tests on Windows against a test vornd it builds, and
# uploads the offscreen renders. Pull requests test Linux in core.yml; this
# covers the Windows-specific paths (ConPTY shells, the window backend).
name: vorn-app windows

# Dispatch only works once this file is on the default branch, so a push to
# the app's branch that touches this file, or the terminal library's Windows
# build, also runs it.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [vornui-client]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/vorn-app.yml'
      - 'packages/core/vendor/libghostty-vt-sys/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  windows:
    runs-on: windows-2022
    timeout-minutes: 120
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: packages/core
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # libghostty-vt-sys builds Ghostty's VT library from source with Zig.
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29 # v2.2.1
        with:
          version: 0.16.0

      - name: Rust
        run: rustup toolchain install

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --profile ci --locked -p vornd -p vorn-sessiond -p vorn-app --bins

      # vornd installs sessiond with the ConPTY that sits beside it.
      - name: ConPTY
        run: node scripts/fetch-conpty.mjs --out target/ci

      - name: Test
        run: |
          mkdir -p shots
          VORN_APP_SHOT="$PWD/shots/windows" cargo test --profile ci --locked -p vorn-app

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: vorn-app-windows
          path: packages/core/shots
          if-no-files-found: warn
tokens: # Runs the desktop app's tests on Windows against a test vornd it builds, and

# libghostty-vt-sys builds Ghostty's VT library from source with Zig.
cargo build --profile ci --locked -p vornd -p vorn-sessiond -p vorn-app --bins
